detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

Semx

Chemical Information:
  • Chemical Name: Semx (N-acetyl-Ser-Glu-His-Phe-Pro-Gly-Pro)
  • Molecular Formula: C37H51N9O10S
  • Molecular Weight: 813.9 g/mol
  • Sequence: Ac-Ser-Glu-His-Phe-Pro-Gly-Pro
Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

This liquid compound is a synthetic heptapeptide consisting of a defined amino acid sequence, modified through N-terminal acetylation to enhance stability. In laboratory environments, Semx is studied for its biochemical properties, peptide stability, and interaction behavior within controlled experimental systems.This product is supplied as a pre-formulated aqueous research solution, intended exclusively for laboratory research use.

Research Applications:
  • Investigation of neuropeptide signaling mechanisms in vitro
  • Study of peptide stability and degradation pathways
  • Evaluation of peptide–receptor interactions under laboratory conditions
  • Comparative research involving short-chain regulatory peptides
Storage and Handling:
  • For optimal stability, store sealed product in a cool, dark, and dry environment. Refrigeration at 2–8 °C is recommended after first puncture or once the seal has been compromised
  • Do not freeze
  • Protect from light
  • Handle using aseptic laboratory techniques
Product Specifications:
  • Formulation: Aqueous solution
  • Concentration: 1.67 mg/mL
  • Total Content: 50 mg per bottle
  • Volume: 30 mL
  • Delivery Format: Metered liquid solution
  • Dispenses per Container: ~200
  • Amount per Dispense: ~250 mcg
  • Analytical Approach to Finished Formulations: Purity is a metric used for isolated raw materials, such as lyophilized peptide powders. Finished formulations—such as capsules, liquids, and topicals—contain multiple components, including excipients and stabilizers. In these systems, a single purity value does not accurately represent the overall composition. Instead, identity and assay (content) are reported on the COA to confirm the presence of the correct compound and to verify that the labeled amount per unit is accurate. This approach reflects standard analytical practice and provides more meaningful information for research applications
Compliance Notice:

Semx is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
